svg.aria-label: Software Development Engineer 2 at OneCX, Nov 2022 to Mar 2025. Only backend engineer on INTERCOMM, a WhatsApp Business API platform: 1M+ messages per quarter. ~100K messages/day per bot at 99.9% uptime on Redis-backed queues. BridgeQ: multi-channel messaging backbone on Kafka and RabbitMQ. 10× client reach, 2× sales revenue and +45% campaign ROI in year one. Provider-credential abstraction so new channels plug in without touching core logic. Owned the GitHub Actions pipelines, Git workflow standards and runbooks.
